items.text: Incorporated all 4 decisions from round 3 into the plan: (1) All phases ship together as one unit — no phased rollout. (2) Testing is vitest-only — no Playwright E2E. (3) Empty state placeholder added to detail page scope and Phase 4 steps. (4) Placeholder text and helper copy added to AcceptanceGlobDialog spec in Phase 3.
All 13 resolved decisions across 3 workshop rounds are now reflected in the plan. The Resolved Decisions section documents each with its round of origin for traceability.

Remaining gap: risk_awareness scored 2/3 because the CLI 405 error is noted but not investigated, and there is no mitigation for the doublestar dependency potentially not being in go.mod. These are minor and can be resolved during implementation.

The plan is execution-ready. All 4 phases have concrete function signatures, component props, test case descriptions, and integration wiring steps. An executing agent can proceed with Required Reading and implement sequentially.

plan_updates: Incorporated round 3 decisions: added empty state placeholder to scope and Phase 4, added helper text and placeholder copy to Phase 3, marked all-phases-together delivery in Resolved Decisions, restricted testing to vitest-only in scope and testing strategy. Added acceptance criteria for new UX elements (helper text, empty state, API tests).
